title: Psalms 57
paragraphs: ¹ Be gracious to me, O God, be gracious — for in you my soul takes refuge; in the shadow of your wings I will shelter until this storm passes. ² I cry to God Most High, to God who fulfills his purpose for me. ³ He will send from heaven and save me, rebuking those who trample me. Selah. God will send his steadfast love and his faithfulness. ⁴ My life is surrounded by lions; I lie down among those who are hungry for blood — people whose teeth are spears and arrows, whose tongues are sharp swords. ⁵ Be exalted, O God, above the heavens; let your glory cover all the earth.

⁶ They set a net for my feet — I was brought low. They dug a pit in my path — but they have fallen into it themselves. Selah. ⁷ My heart is steadfast, O God, my heart is steadfast! I will sing and make music. ⁸ Awake, my soul! Awake, harp and lyre! I will awaken the dawn. ⁹ I will give thanks to you, Lord, among the peoples; I will sing praises to you among the nations. ¹⁰ For your steadfast love reaches to the heavens, your faithfulness to the skies.
¹¹ Be exalted, O God, above the heavens; let your glory be over all the earth.
